description: Enhancing Agricultural Water Management with SWMM is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Ji-Hyeon Shin, WONHO NAM (Hankyong National University). This dataset supports the study titled "Enhancing Agricultural Water Management with SWMM: A Comparative Analysis of Gate Control Strategies in South Korea," submitted to Water Resources Research. Coverage: national (KR); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
